scope: Isolated local Splunk Enterprise with TA-grounded synthetic events

environment.lab_lifecycle: Owned by the coordinating agent under the repository lab lock

resources.unrestricted_container_limits_note: Zero container resource limits mean no explicit limit within the Docker VM, not unlimited host capacity.

tls_deployment_shape_evidence.note: First post-restart attempt failed the unchanged guard; subsequent verified TLS request qualified standalone. Initial failure cause is not established.

python_lint.evidence: Ruff checks passed across tools and tests.

splunk_integration.skip_reason: Destructive migration opt-in is qualified separately by both recorded live-origin runs.

native_splunk_browser.scope: Two synthetic local V2 paths as restricted viewer, exact graph counts, attachments, wireless association and SSID number, reload, live Find, zero demo fallback, normal browser exit.

scheduled_load_probe.scope: raw ingestion, scheduled history/v2 retention, observed cadence and full content/multiplicity parity
scheduled_load_probe.restrictions: Not a saturation test, collector/exporter validation, distributed/SHC/Cloud qualification, or end-to-end graph latency measurement. Graph-only source and UI changes after this run require their own functional checks; measured writers were unchanged.

migration_disabled_origin.scope: Nonempty staged V2 conversation/traffic data, client history and catalog; scheduler-owned cycle/source parity; public selector cutover and smoke searches; original configuration restoration and rollback smoke searches.
migration_disabled_origin.limitations: Resumed after diagnosed failures; four scheduler job artifacts had operator-extended TTL with verified readbacks. This does not establish unattended long-interruption recovery or enabled-origin gap recovery.

migration_enabled_origin.scope: Real scheduled V1 baseline, synthetic event during writer pause, manual missed-window recovery, exact content and selector restoration.
migration_enabled_origin.limitations: Retained journal resumed after authentication refresh and scheduler-boundary refusal. First V1 scheduler artifact retained for 7200 seconds with readback during delayed-dispatch diagnosis; no replacement scheduled job dispatched.

cleanup_regression.review: Independent Astra static review closed the cleanup finding.

final_appinspect.note: Validated candidate containing refreshed fixtures; subsequent qualification-document edits do not alter runtime files. Cloud acceptance remains separate.

independent_final_review.review: Independent GPT-6 Astra static review found no new correctness blocker. Recaptures preserve graph counts, topology content apart from timestamps/order, catalog sizes and Find coverage. Full local evidence is recorded separately; real collectors, SHC, Cloud and production capacity remain unqualified.

cisco_topology_remediation.scope: Live scoped inventory, aliases, source-grounded interface mappings and existing Meraki AP uplinks

cisco_partial_ownership_regression.scope: Partial IP ownership, known-MAC disambiguation, IP-only conflict, and malformed-MAC competitor refusal

cisco_path_remediation.scope: Positive ACI and NX-OS paths, exact selected Hubble tuple exclusion, independent aggregate backend evidence, MAC-aware IP reuse, roaming, replay, invalid and unmapped records

cisco_handoff_coverage.scope: Both platforms preserve exact unresolved client handoffs; ACI independently supported aggregate remains observed with partial frontend coverage

numeric_vlan_history_regression.command: ADM_LAB=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/splunk -p test_endpoint_network.py -v; ADM_LAB=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/splunk -p test_network_history.py -v
numeric_vlan_history_regression.scope: Numeric and string VLAN preservation, missing/null/empty sample completeness, endpoint network and temporal history regressions

cisco_restricted_permissions.scope: Search-only viewer scope, denied protected writes/dispatch, graph/topology/catalog/Find/health access, and full admin/viewer topology parity. Three exact incomplete-topology warnings are expected; unmapped ESXi vmnic2 links remain absent.

v2_search_invocation_parity.scope: Restricted-viewer graph and topology parity between implicit and explicit search; generated_at validated separately; protected write and dispatch denial.

v2_search_contract_review.result: No actionable findings; live qualification remains separate.

catalyst_missing_fields.scope: Shipped SPL expression requires explicit wired/connected/Switch/interface evidence; missing/null/empty fields remain unresolved.

final_fixture_capture.reconciliation: Capture refused a packaged app.conf fingerprint left by archive upgrade tests. All search/parsing defaults matched; current source reinstalled before dataset regeneration.

migration_review.scope: Schedule aliases, public macro formatting, saved-search identity readiness, strict reconciliation, raw qualification range, scheduler job identity and delayed dispatch bounds. Both local migration origins passed with documented diagnostic retention and resumption.

frontend_independent_review.scope: Network-client Find and partial failures, stale-result cancellation, live/demo map targets, Setup incomplete states, source-qualified matching, traffic metric restrictions and exports. No additional actionable defects.

shared_pipeline_independent_review.scope: Normalization, history, topology, counters, schedules and ACLs; disabled-writer manual dispatch correction independently reviewed and exercised in the passing disabled-origin migration.

migration_result_schemas.evidence: Read-only complete live searches for v1/v2 graph, catalog, Find, health, conversation evidence, topology, plus network-client history and V2 traffic evidence. Uses epoch-zero lower bound; nested observations and row-specific identity fields validated.

upgrade_harness_unit.evidence: Pure phase-aware resume, durable gap-injection intent, fail-closed reconciliation, bounded artifact validation, and terminal rollback proof.

migration_result_artifacts.evidence: Bounded secure immutable result artifacts fixed the prior v19 16 MiB journal-size failure; retained disabled-origin journal completed in v22.

scheduler_artifact_retention.scope: Four existing scheduler artifacts retained during diagnosis; no searches dispatched. Newer artifacts keep their original TTL.

scheduler_job_identity.evidence: Live Splunk 10.6 job-list entry.name is search text; content.sid supplies identity and entry.id is a URL. All four migration job-list consumers now validate content.sid and matching URL path.
scheduler_job_identity.review: Independent GPT-6 Astra bounded review found no blocker; live qualification remains in progress.

capture_result_completeness.review: Independent Astra review closed result-truncation handling; explicit null and malformed values are rejected.

ci_browser_overlay_regression.cause: Candidate path overlay remained open over the final network-card click in two browser tests.
ci_browser_overlay_regression.fix: Close the path through its visible button after path assertions; assertions and timeouts unchanged.
ci_browser_overlay_regression.review: Independent Astra static review confirmed selected-path and aggregate assertions are preserved.

lab_cleanup.scope: Disposable container, volumes, lab image and lab secrets removed; exclusive lock released.

release_policy: Keep the pull request draft and do not merge while required qualification is outstanding.
limitations: Prepared HEC events validate documented event handling, not live controller collection or exporter decoding.
Local workload measurements do not establish production capacity or distributed equivalence.
Interrupted or failed load-probe attempts are unqualified and are not capacity evidence.
Wireless attachment is correlated from Meraki association and flow evidence; missing or conflicting evidence stays unresolved.
SD-WAN flow references do not establish TLOC relationships or an asserted packet route.
